description_en: June to October 2020: eleven free online talks on veterinary pathology and medicine for students in Nigeria, across Africa and anywhere else. Every speaker, every date, and the registrations the old event pages recorded.
description_zh: 2020 年 6 月到 10 月：十一场免费线上讲座，主题是兽医病理与兽医学，面向尼日利亚、全非洲以及世界各地的学生。每位讲者、每个日期，以及旧活动页记录的报名人数。
